description.value: L'Hermitage is a 60-room luxury boutique hotel at the corner of Robson and Richards Streets in the heart of downtown Vancouver, blending European chic with West Coast sophistication. It offers a range of rooms and suites, including studio units with fully equipped Eggersmann kitchens and in-unit washer/dryers, alongside a rooftop heated outdoor pool, 24-hour fitness studio, and the on-site L'Orangerie dining room and lounge. The property caters primarily to business and leisure travelers seeking a high-end boutique experience in a central urban location.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms the OSM address, phone number (778-327-4100), and URL. The amenities page lists outdoor pool, fitness studio, and business centre but makes no mention of bike storage, bike procedures, or cycling-specific services anywhere across the fetched pages. Wi-Fi is supported by both the OSM tag (internet_access=wlan, internet_access:fee=no) and website references to high-speed internet; in-room laundry is confirmed for the Boutique Solarium Room and some suites; on-site dining (L'Orangerie) confirms nearby evening food.
concerns: The About page lists a different email domain (guest.services@hermitagevancouver.com) compared to the domain used on all other pages (guest.services@lhermitagevancouver.com) — possible outdated content or typo.
The About page also lists a toll-free reservations number (1-888-855-1050) not present in OSM; this appears to be an additional line rather than a contradiction.
No cycling amenities (bike storage, e-bike charging, bike wash, tools) are mentioned anywhere on the website, making this property an uncertain fit for the WWC directory without further verification.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: No mention of bike storage or any cycling-specific services anywhere on the website; the sole required criterion (secure overnight bike storage) cannot be confirmed. A direct inquiry to the property would be needed before inclusion.
